name: Suhl (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Suhl (red towers with a hammer and a hen on yellow and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Suhl; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Suhl arms — towers, hammer and hen
